summary: Busy shopfront kerb in Indooroopilly where cars park; apartments about 23 m off.
reasons: Shops and car parks, no homes close
Busy retail strip, van would be seen

best_section.where: Riverview Terrace east kerb, south of the corner cafe, beside the commercial car park

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto shops and customer car parks; nearest dwellings are apartments about 23 m away at the south end.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking lane with other cars parked; room to pull in clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy town-centre street with a junction at the north end; steady daytime traffic.
drivers.convention: Signed 1/4P, 2P and loading zone in daytime; cars park here but it is a retail strip, not a sleeping spot.

flags: Daytime time limits and loading zone signs nearby
No Stopping signs at the north end
Noise from junction and cinema precinct
Mapped gates are not on the access
sun_shade: Open kerb; trees at the south end shade the east side in the morning.
